description:
The hospital administration requires the OpenMRS system default locale to be changed to French. 

Starting from the Bahmni home screen, log in as the administrator (Username: 'superman', Password: 'Admin123'). 

Navigate to the OpenMRS Administration interface (often accessed via the 'OpenMRS' link or by appending /openmrs/admin to the URL). Locate the Global Properties management section (sometimes labeled 'Maintenance' -> 'Settings' or 'Advanced Settings'). 

Find the global property named 'default_locale' and change its value from 'en' to 'fr'. Save the change. 

Verify that the setting has been updated.
